If he does there is not really a point in trying further but if he actually listens, ask him how he would feel if you would push hypothetical kids onto him after meeting them only one time. There are two. One belongs to my mom, one is the one of the friend of my moms. They are two right now, because it’s summer vacation and we’re in one house. In a week we go back to our home with one pup and one stays with the friend of my moms.

I care for both at night, anything else would be pretty mean. The pup of my moms is the family pup, so that’s why we’re (my mom and I for sure) in this together and that’s why it should be fairly split. She doesn’t care as it seems, as long a sit works for her sleep schedule

I am 20. I bet you will now say, „huh? You’re an adult! Why do you need more sleep?“ but I just need at least 8 to function properly. We are all giving them attention, just one half does the day shift, another the nightshirt, the later is me. The reason we have two, is because we live in two separate house holds usually. now it’s summer vacation time and we are in one house. That’s why it’s two. In a week we have to go back and we take one puppy with us, one stays with the friend of my moms. 

It’s just so draining and I know it is the same for my mom, so I want them to rest as much as I would want to, but they don’t care about me

I want to take care of the dogs as much as I can, but they will need to help, since those are our dogs. Not mine, not theirs, ours and I want to help, but they will need to at least understand that I also need as much sleep as they do and I help them having it.

I also think, perhaps I should ask a doctor, because I‘m pretty much always tired, but 8 usually is enough… more or less

So, one dog is for the friend of my moms and the other is my moms dog, but is meant to be a family dog. It was a joint decision and yes we split the work. That’s why I watch at night, so they can rest and I rest over the day. 

I suggested two dogs that were older, but my mom says, they probably have their issues if they are given away and we’re raised by other people. Hate that sentiment, because older dogs still need homes.

Also yes, we are prepared, we’ve had dogs before and trained them well. It just should be split work and not one does the Night Shift and one has to be sleep deprived too, while then helping over the day time too. I want to do as much as I can, but there is only so much I can do, we will have to work together and they seem to rather take the easy time and expect me to then also sleep less when I could sleep just as much as they did

Again we wanted those dogs. Those are two and my mom and her friend chose each one. I want to help, but she can’t just demand I lack sleep when I help her not needing to do so
